reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) shows that Y and Hf co-doping increases lattice distortion, which elevates vacancy formation energy and reduces Al diffusion in an oxidation context, but it does not address dislocation climb or creep behaviour. The link from diffusion suppression to creep resistance is therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Adding Hf increases lattice distortion in NiCoCrAl-type coatings
Increased lattice distortion elevates vacancy formation energies
Elevated vacancy formation energies impede dislocation climb
Impeded dislocation climb reduces creep rate under high-temperature stress
